verdict.rationale: cfo.ai ships a built-in assistant, Ari, that takes delegated tasks inside the product. The docs show it rebuilding a workbook as a live Model, syncing sources on request, adding or removing synced tables, generating scenarios from one-line asks, and keeping the model current, with every write undoable and a per-tool allow/ask/deny approval policy. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works as claimed, and detailed first-party docs on the in-app chat workflow (evidence is short marketing and doc snippets).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Have Ari rebuild your workbook as a live Model, then check that it ties.
Sync QuickBooks or another connected source now with Sync now or by asking Ari
ask Ari to add or remove tables later, such as syncing one more table from Postgres
Scenarios you ask for in one line: a hire wave, a slipped quarter, a downside growth case, several at once.
Ari builds the model and keeps it current, then messages you when something moves rather than waiting to be asked.
runs under a per-tool allow, ask, or deny policy with human approval.
